analysis:
FactChecker rated this claim false using Budget data. Comparing three-year totals, capital expenditure was about Rs 6.9 lakh crore under Modi's first three years and Rs 5.15 lakh crore in the previous government's last three years, a rise of roughly a third rather than the near-doubling implied by the quoted yearly figures.

The fact-checker's exact comparison basis was only summarised in the source we could read.
notes: Only the summary table from BOOM's republication was read; the Budget documents themselves were not opened and the generic indiabudget.nic.in link is the only primary link available. Reviewer should obtain the specific Budget tables.
